fieldValues.statement: A governance decision is a pure function, stated once, over the same decision made where it is needed
fieldValues.boundary_clause: unless the decision is presentation only (how a list is ordered on screen), which a client may own.
fieldValues.context: Any rule about who may merge, claim, ratify, pause or escalate. Enforces 926c059f rules 1–3. The same lean as e78b0f66 (Core service over adapter logic), which holds only within SRS implementation; this states it for the clerk.
